rites.name: Alaaraenae
rites.text: Alaaraenae is the concept of the first sounding, the note by which the roots of Ninteostor gathered into one hold of earth and water during the Singing. Within the Age of the first sovereign it is remembered as the pattern that let groves take shape before kingdoms could grow upon them.

rites.name: Elanimiel
rites.text: Elanimiel is the concept of resonance itself as it was heard during the Singing, when the first roots of Ninteostor condensed out of a shared tone. In the Age of Strangers, outsiders who anchored their own songs to her note were permitted to trade across the forming world.

rites.name: Guthar
rites.text: Guthar is the concept of the Forged Gate, the will that holds open the doors between worlds during the Courts of Ninteostor. Its power is measured in the sealing of temples and the bending of flame, rarely in the breaking of stars.

rites.name: Drokaggun
rites.text: Drokaggun is a concept of the Seeding, the quiet season when the makers plant the Weave and the powers of Ninteostor lie dormant beneath the groves. It is less a force than a pattern of sleeping potential that the first sovereign learns to wake gently in the growing kingdoms.

rites.name: Ilyinnamae
rites.text: Ilyinnamae is the concept of a binding oath, the thread that held the broken worlds of Ninteostor together when the Sundering split its Shards apart. In the Fall she was the first to speak the words of the Pact, and her voice is said to still echo in the fractured seams between realms.

rites.name: Credurnon
rites.text: Credurnon is the invented concept of Ninteostor's Walled Age, a belief in holding walls and the orders that kept them standing. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between peoples, the concept was tested and reshaped by first crossings over the breaking borders.

rites.name: Valentaunia
rites.text: A bright-eyed trickster keeps a fallen wanderer propped up as a living emblem. The stunt confuses everyone who passes through the valley of Ombrel Fen.
